name: miami
title: Miami
description: Ocean Drive at nightfall: art deco hotels with stepped parapets and neon trim, the glass towers of Brickell behind, still palms and neon reflections in the bay.

name: tokyo
title: Tokyo
description: Tokyo at night in coloured dots: Tokyo Tower glowing orange and white with both decks lit, a deep city in faint cyan haze and a moonlit, snow-capped Mount Fuji under a teal sky.

name: new-york
title: New York
description: Manhattan at night from across the river: One World Trade Center, the Empire State and Chrysler buildings, a skyline of lit windows and a slow ferry on calm water.

name: paris
title: Paris
description: The Eiffel Tower lit gold at blue hour over the Seine, between Haussmann rooftops and the dome of Les Invalides, with one slow bateau-mouche.

name: london
title: London
description: Westminster at night across the Thames: the Elizabeth Tower with its lit clock, the Palace of Westminster, Tower Bridge and the Shard, with amber lamps on the embankment.

name: dubai
title: Dubai
description: Dubai at night from the water: the Burj Khalifa stepping up to its spire and beacon, the Emirates Towers, the Marina and the sail of the Burj Al Arab, with lit windows and calm reflections.

name: san-francisco
title: San Francisco
description: The Golden Gate Bridge at night: orange towers with stepped portals, the main cable dipping to the deck, the Marin Headlands, a low fog bank and the downtown skyline with the Transamerica Pyramid and Salesforce Tower.

name: hong-kong
title: Hong Kong
description: Victoria Harbour at night from Kowloon: a wall of lit towers below the ridge of Victoria Peak, with Central Plaza, the Bank of China Tower and Two IFC, calm reflections and the Star Ferry.

name: rio
title: Rio de Janeiro
description: Rio de Janeiro at night from the sea: Sugarloaf with its cable car, Christ the Redeemer lit white on Corcovado, and the lamps of Copacabana on a calm bay.

name: sydney
title: Sydney
description: Sydney Harbour at night: the Opera House lit cream-white on its podium, the Harbour Bridge behind it, Circular Quay's towers and one ferry on calm water.
